<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 31:7">Targ. Ps. XXXI, 7</cite> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="O00299"><he>שׂ׳</he></cite>); a. fr. (interch. with <cite ref="O00068"><he>שְׂ׳</he></cite>).—Part. <cite ref="O00019"><he>סָנֵי</he></cite>, (<cite ref="O00019"><he>סָאנֵי</he></cite>); f. <cite ref="O01228"><he>סַנְיָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>מָנִין</he>, <cite ref="O01244"><he>סָנָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:16">Targ. Prov. VI, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 26:28">Ib. XXVI, 28</cite> (some ed. <he>שָׂא׳</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 8:13">Ib. VIII, 13</cite> (Bxt. <cite ref="O01160"><he>סַנְאָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 1:22">Ib. I, 22</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 3:2">Targ. Mic. III, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yoma 9b:15">Yoma 9ᵇ</cite> <he>באלהא דסָנֵינָא לכו</he> Ms. M. (<he>אלהא ס׳</he>) by God, we hate you (Babylonians).
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b">Keth. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>לא לידון … דסָ׳ ליה</he> one must not act as judge in the case of one he loves, or of one he hates.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מינייהו סָנוּ לי</he> some of them hate me.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>או מִסְנֵי כולהו סמו לי</he> (not <he>מסנו</he>) if there is hating (among them), they all hate me.
<cite ref="Shabbat 153a:3">Sabb. 153ᵃ</cite> <he>דסני ליה כולהו וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>דסנו</he>) whom all the people of Pumbeditha hate.
<cite ref="Shabbat 26a:2">Ib. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>דהוות סניא לכלתה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>סְנִיאָה לה לכלתה</he>) who hated her daughter-in-law.

<cite ref="Pesachim 113b:5">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>ומי שריא למִסְנַיֵיה</he> (some ed. <he>למִסְנֵיה</he>) is it permitted to hate a fellowman? <cite ref="Pesachim 113b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו למימרא … למִישְׂנַיְיהוּ</he> (Yalk. Ms. <he>למִסְנַיֵיה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) is it permitted to denounce him to his teacher that he may hate him? <cite ref="Pesachim 113b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מִסְנֵא סנו ליה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מִיסְנֵי סני</he>) they should hate him.
M. Kat. 17ᵃ דהוו סנו שומעניה whose reputation people disliked (who was ill-reputed, v. infra); a. fr.—Part. pass. סְנֵי, סְנִי; f. סַנְיָא hated, hateful; ungainly, unsavory.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 14:20">Targ. Prov. XIV, 20</cite> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="O00019"><he>סאני</he></cite>; h. text <he>יִשָּׂנֵא</he>).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:6">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>דעלד סני וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00113"><he>חַבְרָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 25b:18">Meg. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דסני שימעניה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דסְנָאֵי</he>, v. supra) one whose reputation is bad, v. <cite ref="B00436"><he>בְּזֵי</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 14b:10">Ib. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>סַנְיָין שמייהו</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="O01223"><he>סני</he></cite>; Ms. Halberst. <he>שַׂנְיָאן</he>; Ms. O. <cite ref="U01586"><he>אִישְׂתַּנֵּי</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) they are ungainly of name; (Ms. M. their names are ungainly).
<cite ref="Taanit 7b:1">Taan. 7ᵇ</cite> top <he>אי הוו סָנוּ וכ׳</he> if they had been ugly, they would have been still greater scholars.
